name: 2.4.1 - Export offset note and churn fix
body: Scheduled exports now include the utc_offset_note column. Churn cards no longer double-count a refund issued after the 03:00 UTC sync.

name: 2.4.0 - First sign-in provisioning and sync indicator
body: Enterprise users are created automatically on first SAML sign-in. Every dashboard shows a last-synced indicator in UTC and in the workspace timezone. The sync window moved from 04:00 UTC to 03:00 UTC.

name: 2.3.0 - NetSuite GL and webhook retry fix
body: NetSuite General Ledger is available on Enterprise plans. Webhook retries now follow the documented backoff of 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 2 hours and 24 hours.
